detail.longDescription: One run on Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench averages 85.3 minutes, 231 episodes and 9.9M tokens. The best of 15 frontier models passes 15.2% of its 46 tasks (reward ≥0.95); the mean is 4.3%. At that length, a final score says little. You want to see where the run turned. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2607.08964 If you want to watch an agent's terminal from your phone while it works, that is what we built: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # Terminal # MachineLearning # OpenSource
